notes: Seven-host H4 FX cointegration universe from approved card QM5_10025. Each setfile runs on one registered host; monthly selection chooses one foreign partner from the other six symbols. The host leg opens through QM_TM_OpenPosition at its registered slot, the foreign partner opens through QM_BasketOpenPosition, and the package risk is beta-weighted across both legs. All seven symbols are registered .DWX instruments.
